newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four hurt in Colombian bread shop grenade blast.
newsitem.headline: Four hurt in Colombian bread shop grenade blast.

text.p: Four people were injured when a hand grenade exploded outside a bread shop on Sunday in a suburb of Cali, Colombia's second largest city, national radio reported.
Witnesses told the authorities that a man on a motorcycle accidentally dropped the device as he rode past the shop in the south of the city, RCN radio said.
The three men and a woman injured in the blast were hospitalized but none were reported to be in serious condition.
